title: Spike: hand-write a minimal .alc from Apricity's warp markers and test it in the DAW
description:
## Intent
Answer M0 questions 3, 4 and 5 for the `.alc`: the smallest document the DAW accepts, and how it references audio.

## Steps
1. Unzip the owner's reference `.alc` files; list every element the AudioClip needs (WarpMarkers, CurrentStart/End, Loop, WarpMode, IsWarped, PitchCoarse/PitchFine, Name, SampleRef/FileRef with its size/checksum/date fields).
2. Hand-write a minimal `.alc` for `steady-120.wav` from Apricity's analysis (its warp markers); drag it from the DAW's browser into a track. Does it play on the grid? Does it need the checksum/size fields, or does it accept zeros?
3. Try: a negative beat (pickup), markers only over part of the audio, a relative path after moving the folder, detune -70 cents.
4. Note the warp-mode numbers and which Apricity modes they map to (Tones and Complex Pro have no Apricity peer).

## Output
The `.alc` section of `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Formats with a minimal annotated example document (no audio).

## Verify (manual)
The hand-written `.alc` opens in the DAW and plays on the grid; the result for each variation in step 3 is recorded with the DAW version.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.

comments.text:
## Findings (provisional: public files, no local DAW)

**Evidence.** 301 public .als/.alc (8.x to 12.4.5b10; 8,488 audio clips with warp markers) scanned in the scratchpad; the AudioClip element of an MIT 12.3.2 set (live-daw-tools/als-parser@94fe482, Michelle-12.3.als) is the reference layout; 12.2.6 .alc pair from elixirbeats/abletoolz@9b23618 (GPL, cited only): one saved by the DAW, one hand-edited (markers, CurrentStart/End, Loop only) that the tool's author reports the DAW accepted on drag-in.

- An .alc is a whole set document (root element with MajorVersion 5 / MinorVersion 12.0_122xx / SchemaChangeCount / Creator / Revision) holding one AudioTrack; the clip sits at LiveSet/Tracks/AudioTrack/DeviceChain/MainSequencer/ClipSlotList/ClipSlot/ClipSlot/Value/AudioClip. Content cannot tell .als from .alc; only the extension.
- WarpMarker has Id/SecTime/BeatTime attributes (Id from 10.x on). 8,486 of 8,488 clips end with a hidden marker exactly 1/32 beat after the last one (vendor API docs: the last marker is not visible); the two exceptions include the hand-edited 12.2.6 file the DAW accepted.
- Negative BeatTime: 43 clips in two 9.0.1 sets pin beat -124 before beat 0; the accepted 12.2.6 hand edit uses CurrentStart/LoopStart -191.72 beats (audio before the first marker, extrapolated at the first segment's tempo). So pickups are representable; untested in 12.3.
- FileRef (12.x): RelativePathType, RelativePath (string), Path (absolute), Type, OriginalFileSize, OriginalCrc (16-bit, algorithm unknown), then LastModDate, DefaultDuration (frames), DefaultSampleRate. 9.x/10.x used RelativePathElement lists, a UTF-16 hex Data blob, SearchHint FileSize/Crc/MaxCrcSize 16384.
- WarpMode enum (vendor API docs): 0 Beats, 1 Tones, 2 Texture, 3 Re-Pitch, 4 Complex, 5 REX, 6 Complex Pro. PitchCoarse -48..48 semitones, PitchFine -50..49 cents (float; -22.58 seen).

**Machine half done.** 9 hand-written candidate .alc files in crates/apricity-daw/tests/fixtures/reference/sidecars/candidates/ (throwaway generator: scratchpad work/make_alc.py), one per step-3 variation: full clip, bare clip (only mapped elements), zero size/CRC, relative path only, partial markers, no hidden tail marker, tempo change at 6.5, detune -70 as coarse -1 + fine +30, unwarped. Click-by-click test steps are in design/daw-sidecars.md. The drag-in results wait on the licensed install.
